matches.title: Solana Summit Canada Creator Challenge - part 1
matches.body:
Road to Solana Summit Canada
Every great event has people who help tell its story.
This is your chance to be one of them.
We’re inviting creators, founders, builders and storytellers to help make Solana Summit Canada the must attend event for Canada’s startup and developer ecosystem.
Create content that inspires founders, developers and creators to join Solana Summit Canada this September.

This is Part 1 of the Solana Summit Canada Creator Challenge.
Part 2 launches during the summit with new challenges and another chance to win.

About Solana Summit Canada
Solana Summit Canada is Canada’s flagship Solana conference.
For two days, founders, developers, investors, researchers and creators from across Canada and around the world come together in Toronto to explore what’s next across blockchain, AI and startups.
Whether you’re building your first product or your next unicorn, this is where ambitious people meet, learn and connect.
📅 September 23 to 24, 2026
📍 Toronto, Canada
🌐 solanasummit.ca (http://solanasummit.ca)
🎟 Register: https://luma.com/Solana-Summit-Canada

Your Mission
Create content that makes people want to be at Solana Summit Canada.
Your audience could be:

- Founders

- Developers

- AI builders

- Students

- Investors

- Curious newcomers

Use your own style.
Videos, threads, podcasts, articles, memes, interviews or something entirely original.
The goal is simple:

- Inspire people to attend.

- Drive registrations.

Categories
🇨🇦 Why Canada?
Show why Canada is building.
🚀 Why I’m Going
Your reason to attend.
👩‍💻 Builder Perspective
Why founders and developers should be there.
🎤 Speaker Spotlight
Highlight a speaker worth seeing.
🌎 Convince Your Community
Bring builders from your city.
Examples: Montréal, Vancouver, NYC, Boston, Chicago…
🤖 AI × Blockchain
Explore the frontier.
🎨 Wildcard
Anything creative.

Prize Pool
We’re rewarding great storytelling across multiple formats and creator styles.
Rather than having every submission compete against a single viral post, we’ll recognize outstanding work across categories as well as the overall best content.

🏆 Rewards
🥇 Grand Prize: $2,000
🥈 Second Place: $1,250
🥉 Third Place: $750
🏅 Fourth & Fifth Place: $500 each
🏅 7 Category Winners: $250 each
⭐ 10 Honorable Mentions: $250 each

Total Prize Pool: $10,000

Don’t limit yourself to one idea. Submit as many pieces of content as you’d like. Every submission is judged on its own merits.

Requirements

- Publish on X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.

- Follow and tag X:@SuperteamCAN, IG: @solanacanada …

- Include the registration link: https://luma.com/Solana-Summit-Canada

- You may also link to solanasummit.ca (http://solanasummit.ca).

- Original content only.

- AI tools are welcome, but the creativity should be yours.

- English and French submissions are accepted. French videos should include English subtitles.

- Multiple submissions are encouraged.

Judging Criteria
We’ll evaluate submissions based on:

- Storytelling

- Creativity

- Production quality

- Engagement

- Ability to inspire people to attend Solana Summit Canada

Timeline
Challenge opens: Immediately
Submission deadline: September 21, 2026
Winners announced: Within two weeks after Solana Summit Canada

About Superteam Canada
Superteam Canada helps builders, founders and creators launch on Solana through community, events and opportunities to learn, earn and build.

Skills: Growth: Marketing, Digital Marketing · Content: Video, Video Editing, Social Media, Writing

Sponsor: Superteam Canada (verified)

matches.title: Hackathon Universitária Superteam Brasil
matches.body:
Esta é uma hackathon feita para quem nunca participou de uma hackathon.
Você não precisa saber programar em Solana. Não precisa ter um produto pronto no fim. Não precisa ter nenhuma experiência com blockchain, criptomoedas ou web3.
O que você precisa é de uma boa ideia para um problema real, e de 5 minutos de vídeo para explicar essa ideia bem.
Você tem 22 dias. Nós damos o material de estudo, o suporte no WhatsApp e as ferramentas. Você traz o problema que quer resolver.
Submissões abertas de 15 de agosto a 5 de setembro. Vencedores anunciados em 15 de setembro.

Quem pode participar

- Estudantes com matrícula ativa em instituição de ensino superior no Brasil, de qualquer curso: graduação ou pós

- Professores são bem-vindos, desde que mínimo 50% da equipe seja composto por universitários ou estudantes de ensino superior

- Times de 2 a 6 pessoas

- Comprovação de matrícula pedida apenas dos times vencedores, agendada em etapas via grupo WhatsApp oficial

- Cada pessoa pode integrar apenas um time

Times mistos são bem-vindos: alguém de design, alguém de administração, alguém de computação. A parte técnica não é o centro da avaliação.

O que fazer
Identifique um problema que você conhece de perto e proponha uma solução que use a Solana. Tracks sugeridas:

- Vida universitária: pagamentos entre alunos, gestão de entidades estudantis, rateio de repúblicas, certificados e histórico acadêmico verificáveis

- Dinheiro e pagamentos: cobrança, transferências, poupança, renda para freelancers e microempreendedores

- Cultura e consumo: jogos, música, eventos, comunidades, ingressos, colecionáveis

- Livre: qualquer problema que não caiba nas categorias acima

Queremos ver projetos com cara de Brasil: problemas que existem aqui, para pessoas daqui. Uma solução simples para uma dor real vale mais do que uma cópia bem executada de algo que já existe lá fora.

Duas direções que valem a pena explorar
Use protocolos que já existem na Solana. Você não precisa construir tudo do zero. O ecossistema tem peças prontas que podem virar a base da sua solução:

- Jupiter: troca entre tokens, roteamento de pagamentos

- Solana Pay: cobrança e pagamento por QR code, útil para comércio físico

- Kamino, marginfi, Drift: rendimento sobre saldo parado, empréstimos, poupança automática

- Metaplex: emissão de itens digitais, ingressos, credenciais e certificados

- Squads: carteiras compartilhadas com múltiplas assinaturas, boas para caixa de entidade estudantil ou república

- Jito, Marinade: staking e distribuição de rendimento

- Helius, Pyth, Switchboard: dados on-chain, preços e infraestrutura de leitura

Explique no pitch quais protocolos você usaria e por quê. Combinar peças existentes de forma inteligente é uma proposta válida, não um atalho.
Aplicativos que rodam dentro de outros aplicativos. Não é obrigatório construir um app próprio que a pessoa precise baixar. Dá para entregar a solução onde o usuário já está:

- Telegram Mini Apps: interface completa dentro do Telegram, sem instalação; funciona bem para pagamentos, jogos e ferramentas de grupo

- Blinks e Actions no X: uma ação da Solana (pagar, doar, votar, mintar) executada direto no post, sem sair da rede social

- Bots de Telegram e WhatsApp conectados a uma carteira

- Extensões e integrações em ferramentas que a pessoa já usa no dia a dia

Para o público universitário brasileiro, isso costuma reduzir muito o atrito de adoção: é a diferença entre pedir para alguém baixar um app e pedir para alguém clicar num link no grupo da turma.

Como participar: passo a passo

- Inscreva-se nesta página e entre no grupo do WhatsApp da Superteam Academy: https://chat.whatsapp.com/BVXYPlcB9R853QnvgzpCRT

- Monte seu time: de 2 a 6 pessoas, todas estudantes

- Escolha um problema que você entende bem

- Estude o básico de Solana no Solana Academy da Superteam Brasil, disponível em (Em breve)

- Grave um pitch de até 5 minutos

- Envie nesta página até 5 de setembro, 23h59

Você pode enviar antes do prazo
Não é preciso esperar 5 de setembro. Assim que seu pitch estiver pronto, envie.
Durante a hackathon vamos acompanhar a evolução dos projetos no WhatsApp e nas redes. Isso não entra na nota: quem enviar no primeiro dia e quem enviar na última hora são avaliados da mesma forma, só pelo material submetido.
O que acompanhar a evolução muda: times que compartilham progresso ficam mais visíveis para mentoria, suporte técnico direcionado e oportunidades dentro da comunidade depois da hackathon.

Requisitos de submissão

- Vídeo de pitch de até 5 minutos, em português, hospedado em link público (YouTube não listado, Drive aberto ou Loom). Legendas em inglês são bem-vindas: parte dos avaliadores e da comunidade Superteam é internacional, e legendar amplia o alcance do seu projeto. Não é obrigatório e não vale ponto.

- Descrição de até 300 palavras: qual é o problema, quem sofre com ele, o que você propõe e por que a Solana faz sentido nessa solução

- Nome completo, instituição, curso e se é estudante ou professor de cada integrante

- Submissão enviada por um integrante, com os demais listados

Opcional (conta como diferencial, não como exigência): protótipo navegável, protótipo validado com usuários reais (ou qualquer evidência de validação: entrevistas, pesquisa, lista de espera, teste com uma turma ou entidade), mockups, landing page, repositório de código ou qualquer demonstração do que já foi construído.

O que o pitch precisa cobrir
Sugestão de estrutura para os 5 minutos:

- ~1 min: o problema, quem sofre com ele e como você sabe disso

- ~1 min: a solução, o que é, em linguagem simples

- ~1 min: por que Solana, o que a blockchain resolve aqui que outra tecnologia não resolveria

- ~1 min: como funcionaria na prática, fluxo do usuário, mockup ou protótipo

- ~1 min: quem é o time e quais seriam os próximos passos

Não é necessário editar profissionalmente. Slides e uma gravação de tela com sua voz bastam.

Uso de IA
Permitido e incentivado, em qualquer etapa: pesquisa, redação, código, design, roteiro. Pedimos apenas que você declare na descrição quais ferramentas usou e no quê.
O que a IA não substitui: a escolha do problema, o conhecimento do contexto e a defesa da ideia no vídeo. É isso que estamos avaliando.

Material de apoio

- Solana Academy da Superteam Brasil, trilha de introdução para quem está começando: (Em breve)

- Wiki da Superteam Brasil: (Em breve)

- Canal #duvidas no WhatsApp, com suporte durante todo o período: https://chat.whatsapp.com/BVXYPlcB9R853QnvgzpCRT

Referências: veja o que já foi feito
Antes de fechar sua ideia, olhe projetos que venceram hackathons e bounties anteriores da Superteam Brasil. Serve para calibrar o nível esperado e para não repetir algo que já existe:

- Listings concluídas e vencedores da Superteam Brasil no Earn: https://superteam.fun/earn/s/superteambr (filtre por Completed)

- Histórico de hackathons anteriores e projetos brasileiros na wiki: (Em breve)

Repare em um padrão: os projetos que ganham raramente são os mais complexos. São os que explicam bem um problema específico e mostram um caminho claro de solução.

Critérios de julgamento

- Problema: é real, específico e bem compreendido (30%)

- Solução: a proposta resolve o problema e é viável (25%)

- Fit cultural: faz sentido para o contexto brasileiro e para o público que atende (20%)

- Uso da Solana: a blockchain tem papel claro na solução, não decorativo (15%)

- Clareza do pitch: a ideia é comunicada de forma compreensível (10%)

Repare no que não está aqui: qualidade de código, sofisticação técnica e completude do produto não são critérios. Um time sem nenhum programador pode vencer esta hackathon.
Também não são critérios: a data em que você enviou e o quanto você compartilhou do processo. A avaliação é feita apenas sobre o vídeo e a descrição enviados.

Perguntas frequentes
Nunca usei blockchain. Consigo participar? Sim. É exatamente para você. Comece pelo Solana Academy.
Meu time não tem programador. Sem problema. A entrega é um pitch em vídeo, não um sistema funcionando.
Preciso ter código no fim? Não. Se tiver, conta como diferencial.
Posso usar ChatGPT ou Claude? Pode, em tudo. Só declare o uso.
Posso enviar uma ideia que já tinha antes? Pode, desde que o material enviado tenha sido produzido durante a hackathon.
Estou sozinho. Não dá para competir individualmente: o mínimo é 2 pessoas. Use o canal #procura-time do Discord ou o grupo WhatsApp oficial para encontrar time.
Precisa ser em inglês? Não, o pitch é em português. Legendas em inglês são opcionais e bem-vindas.
Preciso esperar o fim do prazo para enviar? Não. Envie quando estiver pronto. Enviar antes não dá pontos e enviar depois não tira: o prazo é só o limite.
Se eu enviar cedo, posso continuar trabalhando? Pode, e vale compartilhar o avanço no WhatsApp. A nota considera o material enviado, mas o acompanhamento conta para mentoria e suporte.
Anúncio dos vencedores: 15 de setembro de 2026
Contato: dúvidas no grupo do evento, https://chat.whatsapp.com/BVXYPlcB9R853QnvgzpCRT

matches.title: Create Content to Engage New Builders for the Hackathon
matches.body:
About Superteam Ukraine
Superteam Ukraine is a web3 community in Ukraine, supported by the Solana Foundation. We help founders, developers, creators, and web3 enthusiasts grow their careers and businesses. We offer bounties, grants, hackathons, educational programs, and networking with top web3 teams in Ukraine and worldwide. Our goal is to support projects from idea to global market entry.

Mission
Create and spread awareness about the Colosseum Hackathon and Superteam, specifically targeting project sign-ups for the hackathon.

Scope Detail

- Develop engaging content about the Colosseum Hackathon and Superteam Ukraine.

- Clearly explain what the hackathon is about, its benefits, and how to participate.

- Highlight Superteam's role in supporting builders and projects within the Solana ecosystem.

- Content should encourage new projects to register for the Colosseum Hackathon through Superteam Ukraine.

- Crucially, implement a method to track the impact of your content on hackathon registrations (e.g., UTM tags, a table of referred projects, or direct contact with us from referred projects).

Submission Requirements

- Content can be in the form of articles, blog posts, videos, social media campaigns, or a combination.

- All submissions must be in Ukrainian.

- Provide a link to your published content (e.g., Google Doc, YouTube link, Twitter thread).

- Include a brief report (1-2 paragraphs) outlining your distribution strategy and where the content was shared.

- Clearly outline the tracking method you used to measure registrations from your content.

Judging Criteria

- Clarity and Engagement: How well the content explains the hackathon and Superteam, and how engaging it is for the target audience.

- Reach and Distribution: The effectiveness of the content's distribution in attracting participants.

- Call to Action: How clearly and effectively the content drives sign-ups for the Colosseum Hackathon.

- Impact Tracking: The effectiveness and clarity of the method used to track referred projects.

- Impact: The number of new projects that register for the hackathon directly attributable to your content.

Reward Structure

- 1st Place: 500 USDG

- 2nd Place: 300 USDG

- 3rd Place: 100 USDG

Skills: Content: Writing, Social Media · Growth: Digital Marketing, Marketing · Other: Data Analytics

matches.body:
About this bounty
Maybe you run a fintech product, an e-commerce operation, a gaming business, a logistics company, or an SME with paying customers. Whatever it is, you know your market better than any Web3 native will.
So here's the question we're asking: is there one part of your business that onchain would solve better?
You don't need to know Solana. You need to know where your current stack breaks.
A few examples. 

- A hardware founder in Vietnam has customers all over the world, but can't run a Kickstarter campaign, because Vietnam isn't among the 25 countries where creators are allowed to launch.

- Ask any small exporter about payments: on smaller invoices, correspondent banking fees and FX spreads can eat 3–5%, and the money takes days to arrive.

- Freelancers working with foreign clients deal with the retail version. The client pays $1,000, about $920 shows up a week later, and the difference is spread across a platform fee, the exchange rate, and whichever banks sat in the middle.

Those are the problems we want to read about. If you know the problem well but haven't worked out the blockchain side, submit anyway and say so. You can work through that part with the team if your submission makes the top.

What you actually get
The 5,000 USDC is the headline, but it's not the most valuable thing here.

- Every top submission gets a working session with our Country Lead. She's built in this market, and she'll tell you what holds up, what doesn't, and what a realistic next step looks like. 

- If you need a technical co-founder, we'll introduce standout founders to builders in our community, whether or not you win anything. 

- And strong ideas don't stop at the bounty: we point them to grants, hackathons, and our founder programs, and make the introductions ourselves.

Your mission
Take your existing Web2 business or product, or one you know deeply as an operator, and design its onchain version on Solana.
Submit a two-page pitch deck plus an MVP or prototype (A prototype can be as simple as a clickable mockup or a flow built on your existing product). Idea-stage submissions are accepted but won't score as well. Vietnamese and English are read equally.
Cover four things:

- The business today. What it is, and the pain point it actually hits.

- Why onchain. This is the core of your pitch. If the honest answer is "it isn't," this bounty isn't for you. Not sure? Tell us exactly where you're doubtful. Honesty about the limits is a plus

- How it works in practice. 

- What's next? What would you do tomorrow with a team and resources?

Who should enter
Founders and operators in fintech, commerce, gaming, logistics, and SMEs. What gets you in the door is a working product, paying customers, or genuine expertise in a space you've spent years in. We'd rather read ten sharp submissions from people who know their market cold than a hundred pitches from people who learned what a blockchain is last month.

Judging criteria

- Who's behind it? At this stage, we're mostly betting on the founder, so show us you actually know this space

- Names a real business and a real pain point

- Answers "Why Onchain" convincingly, not just blockchain, because it sounds good

- Shows how it works, with concrete next steps rather than a concept on paper

- Bonus: a model that could grow into a fundable company

- Bonus: designed to fit Vietnam's regulatory framework as it takes shape

Rewards
Total prize pool: 5,000 USDC

- 1st: 2,500 USDC

- 2nd: 1,000 USDC

- 3rd, 4th, 5th: 500 USDC each

Duration
📅 Submissions open July 13th through August 2nd.
👉Follow @SuperteamVN (https://x.com/@SuperteamVN) for what lands next this month. 🇻🇳

- Inspire someone.

If your content does one or more of these well, you're moving the project forward.

Motion isn't just about moving markets.

Create with intention.

Write with conviction.

Tell stories that people remember.

Because great communities aren't built by the loudest voices.

They're built by the people who believe enough to keep moving.

matches.title: Creator Program: Tell the story that brings Thailand's next talent to Solana
matches.body:
About the Bounty
Thailand has a growing ecosystem of founders, developers, AI builders, creators, operators, investors, and technology communities.
But much of this talent still discovers Solana through crypto native channels.
There is an opportunity to change that.
Superteam Thailand is looking for storytellers who can make Solana relevant to the people already building companies, products, and communities in Thailand.
The goal is simple:
Show people why Solana matters.
Show people why Thailand matters.
Show ambitious builders what they could build next.
We are looking for creators, filmmakers, editors, writers, designers, researchers, and storytellers who can create original public content that reaches audiences beyond the existing crypto ecosystem.
The best submissions will not simply generate views.
They will make someone who has never seriously considered Solana stop, understand the opportunity, and take a next step.
That could mean joining the community, attending an event, meeting another builder, exploring Solana technology, starting a project, or considering Thailand as a place to build.

Your Mission
Create and publish original, public-facing content that introduces Solana and the Thailand builder ecosystem to founders, developers, AI builders, technology talent, and ambitious creators.
Your content should answer at least one of these questions:

Why Solana?
What makes Solana relevant to someone building a real company, product, application, or technology business?

Why Thailand?
Why should ambitious founders and builders consider Thailand as a place to live, build, hire, connect, and grow? Think Founder Arbitrage.

Who is already building?
Who are the people, startups, developers, creators, and communities already doing interesting work from Thailand?

What could be built next?
What opportunities exist at the intersection of Solana, AI, consumer technology, fintech, DeFi, payments, gaming, creator economies, or other emerging sectors

Why should someone care now?
What is happening in Thailand and Solana that a founder or builder outside the existing ecosystem may be missing?

Content Territories
You can choose the format and platform that best fits your audience.
Ideas include:

- Founder interviews and profiles

- Thai startup and builder stories

- Short form video for TikTok, Reels, X, YouTube Shorts, or Facebook

- X or LinkedIn essays

- Technical explainers for non crypto audiences

- AI × Solana use cases

- Profiles of developers and technical talent in Thailand

- "Build in public" series following a real founder or project

- Stories from Superteam Thailand events, coworking sessions, mixers, hackathons, and community activities

- Thailand's DTV and its relevance to international founders

- Cost of living and cost of building in Thailand

- "Founder arbitrage" stories around talent, capital, lifestyle, and access

- Solana ecosystem explainers designed specifically for Thai founders

- Stories comparing traditional startup infrastructure with what is now possible onchain

- Thai English bilingual content

- Data driven stories about Thailand's technology and startup ecosystem

- Original research or visual storytelling around building in Thailand

These are starting points, not restrictions.
The format is up to you. The outcome is what matters.

What Makes a Strong Submission?
We are looking for content that does more than explain crypto.
A strong submission should:
Reach a new audience
Get in front of founders, developers, creators, students, investors, operators, or technology communities that are not already deeply embedded in crypto.
Tell a real story
Feature real people, real companies, real builders, real data, or real opportunities.
Make Solana relevant
Explain the practical reason someone should care about building on Solana.
Make Thailand relevant
Show why Thailand offers something meaningful to ambitious builders.
Create curiosity
Leave the audience wanting to learn more.
Drive action
Give the audience an obvious next step.
Have distribution
Demonstrate that you understand where your audience already spends attention and how to reach them.

Evaluation Criteria
Submissions will be evaluated across five areas.

1. Storytelling — 25%

- Strong opening or hook

- Clear narrative

- Memorable idea

- Appropriate production quality

- Keeps the audience engaged

2. Founder & Builder Relevance — 25%

- Relevant to people building real products or companies

- Communicates a practical opportunity

- Makes Solana understandable outside crypto

- Demonstrates why Thailand matters

3. Distribution — 20%

- Reaches audiences beyond existing crypto communities

- Strong platform and audience fit

- Evidence of thoughtful distribution

- Views, engagement, shares, saves, comments, or inbound interest

4. Clarity — 15%

- Core idea is understood quickly

- "Why Solana?" is clear

- "Why Thailand?" is clear

- Avoids unnecessary crypto jargon

5. Originality & Reusability — 15%

- Original research, interviews, footage, analysis, or creative concept

- Brings a perspective that has not already been repeated across crypto media

- Creates an asset that Superteam Thailand can continue to amplify

What We Want to See
We are particularly interested in work that crosses the boundary between crypto and the wider technology ecosystem.
For example:
A founder who has never used Solana discovers why it is relevant to their product.
A developer learns about an opportunity they did not know existed.
An AI builder sees a use case they want to explore.
An international founder discovers Thailand as a potential base.
A Thai founder realizes there is a global ecosystem they can plug into.
A mainstream technology audience becomes curious about what is happening on Solana.
The best content should make someone think: "I didn't know this was happening in Thailand."

Submission Requirements
Submit:

1. Published Content
Public links to all submitted content.

2. Performance
Include available:

- Views

- Reach

- Engagement

- Shares

- Saves

- Comments

- Clicks

- Followers gained

- Inbound messages or leads

3. Analytics
Provide screenshots of platform analytics where detailed performance data is not publicly visible.

4. Source Material
Where applicable, provide:

- Raw footage

- Design files

- Project files

- Editable source files

- Research or supporting material

This allows Superteam Thailand to continue amplifying strong work.

5. Content Context
Include a short explanation covering:

- Who was the target audience?

- Why did you choose this format?

- Why did you choose this platform?

- How did you distribute it?

- What action did you want the audience to take?

- What happened after publication?

Language
Content may be created in:

- English

- Thai

- Thai and English

Bilingual content is encouraged when it can effectively reach both local and international audiences.

Resources
Superteam Thailand Telegram (https://t.me/SuperteamTH?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Solana (https://solana.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Superteam Thailand Linktree (https://linktr.ee/superteamth?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Creators are also encouraged to research independently and speak directly with builders, founders, and ecosystem participants.

Terms
Participation in this bounty is voluntary.
This bounty is intended to encourage experimentation, storytelling, and contribution to the broader technology and Web3 ecosystem. It is not full time employment or a project based engagement.
Participants are responsible for ensuring that their submissions are original and that they have the necessary rights to use any third party material.
Superteam Thailand may amplify, repost, or reference strong submissions across its public channels.
Due to the volume of submissions, Superteam Thailand may not be able to provide individual feedback to every participant.

The Challenge
Don't make another crypto video.
Find the story that makes a founder, developer, AI builder, or technology creator who has never cared about Solana stop and pay attention.

Why now?

matches.title: Write an X Thread Explaining Echoes & Encouraging Story Recordings
matches.body:
About Echoes Fans
Echoes is a Web3 audio storytelling platform built on Solana. We let real people record their stories, lessons, and experiences and turn them into tradeable digital tokens that are stored forever on the blockchain. We're all about letting your narrative shine and creating a new way to earn from your life experiences.

Mission
Create an X (Twitter) thread that explains Echoes and encourages readers to record their own stories on the platform.

Scope Detail

- Explain what Echoes is in a clear and engaging way.

- Highlight the core value proposition: turning personal stories into tradeable digital tokens.

- Emphasize the perpetual royalty model where creators earn every time their story tokens are traded.

- Encourage users to record their own stories by showcasing the variety of content suitable for the platform (e.g., life advice, founder journeys, vacation stories, romantic tales).

- Website link: https://app.echoes.fans/

- Address the accessibility of the platform: no expensive gadgets needed, no need to show your face, suitable for all ages.

- Include guidelines for recording: find a quiet place, speak clearly into your phone's mic, keep stories concise, add a cover image, and provide an explicit description.

- Mention the current public demo where users can record and launch tokens for free, with Echoes covering the token launch fees.

- Hint at future perks for early creators.

Submission Requirements

- The submission must be an X ( Twitter) thread.

- The thread must be written in English.

- The content should clearly explain Echoes and persuade readers to record their stories.

- The bounty participant must follow Echoes Fans on X https://x.com/echoes_fans.

- The bounty participant must like and comment on the specified X post https://x.com/echoes_fans/status/2087195036177809861?s=20.

- Provide a link to your X thread as the submission.

Judging Criteria

- Clarity and Persuasiveness: How well the thread explains Echoes and convinces readers to record their stories.

- Creativity and Engagement: The originality and appeal of the thread's content.

- Adherence to Guidelines: How well the thread incorporates all requested points, including recording tips and benefits.

- X ( Twitter) Engagement: The level of engagement (likes, retweets, comments) the thread receives.

Reward Structure

- 1st Place: 120 USDC

- 2nd Place: 80 USDC

- 3rd Place: 50 USDC

The reward pool may be increased if we receive more high-quality submissions than expected.

Skills: Content: Writing, Social Media

Sponsor: Echoes Fans

Sponsor contact: https://t.me/topdogtop
